system.description:
You may take an action (usually Attune) and push yourself to do one of the following (you also gain the benefits of pushing yourself)

    • Unbind the elements - you call upon raw elemental power. Create a small, localized event (a bolt of lightning, a sudden windstorm, heavy cloud or fog, a chilling frost, a blazing fire)

    • Unravel the Curtain - you create an area of concentrated arcane energy. All spells and magical effects within it gain increased effect. The outcome of the action roll determines how well you can control the size, shape, and duration of the area, but it can be no larger than one hundred feet in diameter and last no longer than one hour.
